name: Gate Hill Day Camp
description_short: Family run day camp in Stony Point beside Harriman State Park for age 3 to entering 10th grade, with heated pools and swim lessons, sports, arts, go karts, zip lines and rock climbing. Older campers can take morning STEM and arts workshops, and teens can join a leader in training program; door to door busing and lunch are part of tuition.
notes: 4, 5, 6 or 7 week options by request. Early care from 7:45 am with breakfast, after care until 6 pm, day by day, as part of the all inclusive package. Busing is door to door except in NYC and some meeting points in other counties. Sparks tutoring program available. Tuition is not posted.
